description: This file implements a web service handler for Kubernetes API group discovery, allowing dynamic addition and removal of API groups, and serving discovery information via HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: rootAPIsHandler
classes.description: Handles API group discovery, manages API groups, and serves HTTP requests for discovery endpoints.

methods.name: AddGroup
methods.description: Adds a new API group to the discovery handler.

methods.name: RemoveGroup
methods.description: Removes an API group from the discovery handler.

methods.name: Groups
methods.description: Returns the list of API groups available for discovery.

methods.name: groupsLocked
methods.description: Returns the API group list with server address info, assumes lock is held.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for API group discovery.

methods.name: WebService
methods.description: Returns a web service object for API group discovery endpoints.
